campaignDescription: Spring Sales Event for AutoNation Toyota Tempe. Pushing new 2026 Camry and RAV4 inventory. Camry from $28,495, RAV4 from $32,990. Toyota is offering $2,000 customer cash on both models plus 2.9% APR for 72 months. Target: first-time buyers and young families in the Phoenix metro area. Emphasize reliability, fuel economy, and Toyota Safety Sense. Need Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok ads. 3-week campaign timing with Memorial Day weekend push.
